units.source_text: “是呵，往后渐渐就要到北风呼啸的季节了，

en.t: Yes, from now on it will gradually become the season when the north wind howls,
so I cannot help worrying a little about sandstorms...

units.source_text: 她忽地瞟了一眼打开着的木头门，

en.t: She suddenly glanced at the open wooden door,

units.source_text: 在她那毫无抑扬顿挫怯生生的语调里，隐藏着一种近乎愚蠢的确信。

en.t: and in her timid, utterly monotonous tone there was hidden a conviction that bordered on foolishness.
